title: HELLPIT
description:
Doomed to dungeon laden with traps, you are doomed to rot and die.
It's up to you to be the first to escape the HELLPIT.
A 3rd person platformer featuring many unique obstacles and traps.
This game is balanced but don't be fool, this game can be hard and tricky.

Key Features• Simple mechanics - just hold W and jump

• Unique - No obstacles and traps layout are the same each time.

• Strategize - This is not straightforward game where you press 'W' key,
 You need to be good with your timing.

• Checkpoints - No save but checkpoints.
 Some obstacles are really hard to pass through.
 But when you made it, you feel like a boss.

• Hard but balanced - Unlike other rage game, this game designed is to be enjoyable challenge.
description_short: 3rd person platformer where you jump and evade around many obstacles and traps laying in the castle.
